source_issues.finding: Architecture describes Q-Former as ~100M parameters, whereas hook and parameter-economics section use 188M. Both retained.

Prose says main.py simulates 256 patches, 32 queries, dim 128 and projection dim 512; actual constants are NUM_PATCH=64, NUM_QUERY=8, PATCH_DIM=QUERY_DIM=16, LLM_DIM=24. It prints attention summaries, not the entire weight matrix, and contains no trained decoder or artifact writer. English values/claims retained.
10 minutes at 1 FPS yields 600 frames unless additional subsampling is specified, not 60. Source says 60; retained.

Immediately after an 8B total model, the source says BLIP-2 is 50x smaller than Flamingo-80B; total-model arithmetic would be 10x. The intended trainable-parameter comparison basis is not stated. Retained without inventing clarification.

Potential original-model inaccuracies in ITG query/text attention direction, pooled-query ITC, original LLaVA projector chronology, and Flamingo resampler-vs-layer cross-attention descriptions. Broad 2026 family/descendant claims and Gemini statements are not established by the lesson code. Translation keeps frozen English; no external sources consulted or silent correction.
Queries are said to be prepended to the text prompt, but loss sequence is written prompt + image + caption. Retained both as in source.
